reportLocalMeasures.name: KPI Order Value Including Freight
reportLocalMeasures.expression: VAR v = SUM(FactOrderItem[item_gmv]) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK(v), BLANK(), "R$ " & SWITCH ( TRUE(), ABS(v) >= 1000000, FORMAT(v/1000000,"0.00") & "M", ABS(v) >= 1000, FORMAT(v/1000,"0.00") & "K", FORMAT(v,"0.00") ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: KPI Merchandise Value
reportLocalMeasures.expression: VAR v = SUM(FactOrderItem[price]) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK(v), BLANK(), "R$ " & SWITCH ( TRUE(), ABS(v) >= 1000000, FORMAT(v/1000000,"0.00") & "M", ABS(v) >= 1000, FORMAT(v/1000,"0.00") & "K", FORMAT(v,"0.00") ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: KPI Freight Value
reportLocalMeasures.expression: VAR v = SUM(FactOrderItem[freight_value]) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK(v), BLANK(), "R$ " & SWITCH ( TRUE(), ABS(v) >= 1000000, FORMAT(v/1000000,"0.00") & "M", ABS(v) >= 1000, FORMAT(v/1000,"0.00") & "K", FORMAT(v,"0.00") ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: KPI Average Order Value
reportLocalMeasures.expression: VAR v = DIVIDE(SUM(FactOrderItem[item_gmv]),DISTINCTCOUNT(FactOrderItem[order_id])) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK(v), BLANK(), "R$ " & SWITCH ( TRUE(), ABS(v) >= 1000000, FORMAT(v/1000000,"0.00") & "M", ABS(v) >= 1000, FORMAT(v/1000,"0.00") & "K", FORMAT(v,"0.00") ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: KPI Payment Value
reportLocalMeasures.expression: VAR v = SUM(FactPayments[payment_value]) RETURN IF ( ISBLANK(v), BLANK(), "R$ " & SWITCH ( TRUE(), ABS(v) >= 1000000, FORMAT(v/1000000,"0.00") & "M", ABS(v) >= 1000, FORMAT(v/1000,"0.00") & "K", FORMAT(v,"0.00") ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Repeat Customers (Period)
reportLocalMeasures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( FactOrders[customer_key] ), NOT ISBLANK ( FactOrders[customer_key] ) && CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( FactOrders ) ) > 1 ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Repeat Rate (Period)
reportLocalMeasures.expression: DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( VALUES ( FactOrders[customer_key] ), NOT ISBLANK ( FactOrders[customer_key] ) && CALCULATE ( COUNTROWS ( FactOrders ) ) > 1 ) ), DISTINCTCOUNT ( FactOrders[customer_key] ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Orders per Customer
reportLocalMeasures.expression: DIVIDE ( COUNTROWS ( FactOrders ), DISTINCTCOUNT ( FactOrders[customer_key] ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: On-Time Review
reportLocalMeasures.expression: CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( FactOrders[review_score] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactOrders[order_status] = "delivered" ), KEEPFILTERS ( NOT ISBLANK ( FactOrders[is_late] ) ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactOrders[is_late] = 0 ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Late Review
reportLocalMeasures.expression: CALCULATE ( AVERAGE ( FactOrders[review_score] ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactOrders[order_status] = "delivered" ), KEEPFILTERS ( FactOrders[is_late] = 1 ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Paying Orders
reportLocalMeasures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT ( FactPayments[order_id] )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Payment Records
reportLocalMeasures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FactPayments )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Average Installments
reportLocalMeasures.expression: AVERAGE ( FactPayments[payment_installments] )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Last Gold Load
reportLocalMeasures.expression: MAXX ( ALL ( GoldLoadAudit ), GoldLoadAudit[completed_at] )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Latest Gold Orders
reportLocalMeasures.expression: MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, ALL ( GoldLoadAudit ), GoldLoadAudit[completed_at], DESC, GoldLoadAudit[gold_run_id], DESC ), GoldLoadAudit[order_rows] )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Latest Gold Items
reportLocalMeasures.expression: MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, ALL ( GoldLoadAudit ), GoldLoadAudit[completed_at], DESC, GoldLoadAudit[gold_run_id], DESC ), GoldLoadAudit[item_rows] )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Latest Gold Payments
reportLocalMeasures.expression: MAXX ( TOPN ( 1, ALL ( GoldLoadAudit ), GoldLoadAudit[completed_at], DESC, GoldLoadAudit[gold_run_id], DESC ), GoldLoadAudit[payment_rows] )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Successful Gold Loads
reportLocalMeasures.expression: COUNTROWS ( ALL ( GoldLoadAudit ) )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Current Order Rows
reportLocalMeasures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FactOrders )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Current Item Rows
reportLocalMeasures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FactOrderItem )

reportLocalMeasures.name: Current Payment Rows
reportLocalMeasures.expression: COUNTROWS ( FactPayments )
